mapper.select: /*selectSellerMpRqBulkQuotationPriceReg*/ SELECT SEQ, BURQ_RFQ_NO, CH_LIST_PRICE, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEP_BURQ_RFQ RFQ WHERE RFQ.BURQ_NO = A.BURQ_NO AND RFQ.BURQ_RFQ_NO = A.BURQ_RFQ_NO AND RFQ.AGENT = A.AGENT) <> 1 THEN '견적번호 오류' WHEN (SELECT STATUS FROM KEP_BURQ_RFQ RFQ WHERE RFQ.BURQ_NO = A.BURQ_NO AND RFQ.BURQ_RFQ_NO = A.BURQ_RFQ_NO AND RFQ.AGENT = A.AGENT) <> 'K1' THEN '견적제출 불가' WHEN IS_NUMBER(CH_LIST_PRICE) = -1 THEN '단가 오류(숫자만 입력 가능)' ELSE '정상' END AS RESULT FROM ( SELECT KEY_1 AS BURQ_NO, KEY_2 AS SEQ, TRIM(KEY_3) AS BURQ_RFQ_NO, TRIM(KEY_4) AS CH_LIST_PRICE, TRIM(KEY_5) AS AGENT FROM BNTTRXL A WHERE DOC_NAME = 'BURQ_PRICE' AND TARGET = #{USER_ID} AND KEY_1 = #{st_burq_no} ) A ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(SEQ)
